texts.name: Mahyar
texts.biography: Mahyar roams the wilderness with the agility and precision of a true marksman. Raised in the shadow of oppression, he learned the ways of the bow to defend the downtrodden and strike back against tyranny.

specialty.name: Bowmen
specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Bowman or Sharpshooter for each level attained after 4th level.
